title: 名言谚语金句库
desc: 收录考研英语一大作文高频引用的英语谚语与名家名言，附示范嵌入句与适用主题。

entries.en: Where there is a will, there is a way.
entries.example: As the saying goes, where there is a will there is a way, and persistence always pays off.
entries.exampleZh: 常言道，有志者事竟成，坚持终会有回报。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②个人品质——论证毅力与坚持，置于第二段例证引入处。

entries.en: Rome was not built in a day.
entries.example: Rome was not built in a day, so lasting progress in language learning calls for patience.
entries.exampleZh: 罗马不是一天建成的，因此语言学习上的持久进步需要耐心。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②学习与教育——论证循序渐进，用于分析段收束。

entries.en: Constant dripping wears away a stone.
entries.example: Constant dripping wears away a stone; a few pages of reading every day will finally pay off.
entries.exampleZh: 水滴石穿；每天读几页书终会有回报。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②个人品质——强调日积月累的效应，宜置于第二段论证。

entries.en: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
entries.zh: 天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水。
entries.example: Thomas Edison reminded us that genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
entries.exampleZh: 托马斯·爱迪生提醒我们，天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水。
entries.note: ①Thomas Edison；②个人品质——论证勤奋胜过天资，用于第二段论证。

entries.en: Actions speak louder than words.
entries.example: Actions speak louder than words, which is why volunteers deserve our genuine respect.
entries.exampleZh: 行动胜于言辞，正因如此志愿者值得我们真诚的尊敬。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②社会公德——论证实践与奉献，可用于第二段或结尾段。

entries.en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
entries.example: As Lao Tzu said, a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
entries.exampleZh: 正如老子所言，千里之行，始于足下。
entries.note: ①Lao Tzu（老子）；②个人品质——号召迈出第一步，适合结尾段收束。

entries.en: Well begun is half done.
entries.zh: 好的开始是成功的一半。
entries.example: Well begun is half done, so a clear plan often saves us half the effort.
entries.exampleZh: 好的开始等于成功的一半，因此清晰的计划常能省下一半力气。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②学习与教育——论证规划的重要性，宜用于建议段。

entries.en: Strike while the iron is hot.
entries.example: We should strike while the iron is hot and seize the chance to improve ourselves.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应当趁热打铁，抓住提升自我的机会。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②经济职业——论证把握时机，用于建议或结论段。

entries.en: Knowledge is power.
entries.example: Francis Bacon was right that knowledge is power in an era of fierce competition.
entries.exampleZh: 在竞争激烈的时代，弗朗西斯·培根说知识就是力量是没错的。
entries.note: ①Francis Bacon；②学习与教育——点明知识价值，首段或末段皆可使用。

entries.en: Live and learn.
entries.example: Live and learn, for every new experience teaches us something we did not know.
entries.exampleZh: 活到老学到老，因为每一次新经历都会教给我们未知的东西。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②学习与教育——论证终身学习，多用于第二段论证。

entries.en: Practice makes perfect.
entries.example: Practice makes perfect, which explains why top athletes train for hours every day.
entries.exampleZh: 熟能生巧，这就解释了为什么顶尖运动员每天训练数小时。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②学习与教育——论证反复练习的必要性，后接例证。

entries.en: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
entries.zh: 教育是你用来改变世界的最强大武器。
entries.example: Nelson Mandela once said that education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
entries.exampleZh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉曾说，教育是你用来改变世界的最强大武器。
entries.note: ①Nelson Mandela；②学习与教育——立意升华句，宜置于结尾段。

entries.en: Reading makes a full man.
entries.example: As Bacon put it, reading makes a full man, and our campus library proves it.
entries.exampleZh: 正如培根所言，读书使人充实，我们校园的图书馆就是明证。
entries.note: ①Francis Bacon；②学习与教育——论证阅读的价值，可用于第二段。

entries.en: United we stand, divided we fall.
entries.example: United we stand, divided we fall, and this truth applies to every team on campus.
entries.exampleZh: 团结则存，分裂则亡，这条真理适用于校园里的每个团队。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②社会公德——论证团结协作，可作第二段主旨句。

entries.en: Many hands make light work.
entries.example: Many hands make light work, so the whole class finished the project ahead of schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 人多好办事，因此全班提前完成了项目。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②社会公德——论证合作效率，多作例证句使用。

entries.en: Two heads are better than one.
entries.zh: 三个臭皮匠，顶个诸葛亮。
entries.example: Two heads are better than one, which is why group discussion often sparks fresh ideas.
entries.exampleZh: 三个臭皮匠顶个诸葛亮，正因如此小组讨论常能激发新想法。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②学习与教育——论证讨论式学习，用于第二段。

entries.en: No man is an island.
entries.example: As John Donne wrote, no man is an island, and mutual help keeps society alive.
entries.exampleZh: 正如约翰·多恩所写，没有人是一座孤岛，相互帮助让社会充满生机。
entries.note: ①John Donne；②家庭情感——论证人与人的联结，适合第二段或末段。

entries.en: Honesty is the best policy.
entries.example: Honesty is the best policy, for a single lie may destroy years of trust.
entries.exampleZh: 诚实为上策，因为一次谎言可能毁掉多年的信任。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②社会公德——论证诚信价值，宜作论证段首句。

entries.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
entries.example: A friend in need is a friend indeed, and true friendship shows itself in hard times.
entries.exampleZh: 患难之交才是真朋友，真正的友谊在艰难时刻显现。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②家庭情感——论证真挚友谊，用于第二段例证。

entries.en: Haste makes waste.
entries.example: Haste makes waste, so we had better weigh every option before making a decision.
entries.exampleZh: 欲速则不达，因此做决定前我们最好权衡每一个选项。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②经济职业——论证谨慎决策，宜用于建议段。

entries.en: Failure is the mother of success.
entries.example: Failure is the mother of success, and every failed experiment taught the team something.
entries.exampleZh: 失败是成功之母，每一次失败的实验都教会了团队一些东西。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②个人品质——论证挫折的价值，用于第二段论证。

entries.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.
entries.example: Every cloud has a silver lining, and the pandemic pushed us to master online tools.
entries.exampleZh: 黑暗中总有一线光明，疫情促使我们掌握了在线工具。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②健康生活——论证危机中的转机，可用于结尾段。

entries.en: Adversity makes a man wise.
entries.example: Adversity makes a man wise, and those who survived hardship often value life more.
entries.exampleZh: 逆境使人明智，经历过苦难的人往往更珍惜生活。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②个人品质——论证逆境的磨炼作用，用于第二段。

entries.en: What does not kill me makes me stronger.
entries.zh: 凡杀不死我的，必使我更强大。
entries.example: Nietzsche claimed that what does not kill me makes me stronger, and setbacks prove it.
entries.exampleZh: 尼采声称，凡杀不死我的必使我更强大，挫折就是证明。
entries.note: ①Friedrich Nietzsche；②个人品质——论证挫折教育，宜放在论证段。

entries.en: Time and tide wait for no man.
entries.example: Time and tide wait for no man, so we should seize the day and act at once.
entries.exampleZh: 时光不等人，因此我们应当抓住当下立即行动。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②学习与教育——论证珍惜时间，用于建议或结论段。

entries.en: An hour in the morning is worth two in the evening.
entries.zh: 清晨一小时抵得上晚上两小时。
entries.example: An hour in the morning is worth two in the evening, so early risers often learn faster.
entries.exampleZh: 清晨一小时抵得上晚上两小时，因此早起的人往往学得更快。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②健康生活——论证规律作息与效率，可用于建议段。

entries.en: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children.
entries.zh: 我们不是从祖先那里继承地球，而是从子孙那里借用它。
entries.example: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children, so green living is a duty.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不是从祖先那里继承地球，而是从子孙那里借用它，因此绿色生活是一种责任。
entries.note: ①美洲原住民谚语；②生态环保——升华环保立意，宜置于结尾段。

entries.en: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago; the second best time is now.
entries.zh: 种树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。
entries.example: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago; the second best time is now, so start today.
entries.exampleZh: 种树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在，所以从今天就开始吧。
entries.note: ①常引作中国谚语（佚名）；②生态环保——号召立即行动，适合结尾段。

entries.en: Every coin has two sides.
entries.example: Every coin has two sides, and artificial intelligence is no exception to this rule.
entries.exampleZh: 凡事都有两面性，人工智能也不例外。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②科技与互联网——引出利弊分析，宜作第二段首句。

entries.en: Science is a good servant but a bad master.
entries.zh: 科学是好仆人，却是坏主人。
entries.example: Science is a good servant but a bad master, so we must guide its use with ethics.
entries.exampleZh: 科学是好仆人却是坏主人，因此我们必须用伦理引导它的使用。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②科技与互联网——论证科技双刃剑，用于论证段。

entries.en: The Internet is becoming the town square for the global village of tomorrow.
entries.zh: 互联网正成为明日地球村的城镇广场。
entries.example: Bill Gates predicted that the Internet is becoming the town square for the global village of tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 比尔·盖茨预言，互联网正成为明日地球村的城镇广场。
entries.note: ①Bill Gates；②科技与互联网——论证网络的社会功能，用于第二段。

entries.en: A nation's culture resides in the hearts and souls of its people.
entries.zh: 一个民族的文化存在于其人民的心灵与灵魂之中。
entries.example: Gandhi believed that a nation's culture resides in the hearts and souls of its people.
entries.exampleZh: 甘地认为，一个民族的文化存在于其人民的心灵与灵魂之中。
entries.note: ①Mahatma Gandhi；②文化传承——升华文化立意，宜用于结尾段。

entries.en: A sound mind in a sound body.
entries.zh: 健全的精神寓于健康的身体。
entries.example: A sound mind in a sound body, so daily exercise benefits both body and mind.
entries.exampleZh: 健全的精神寓于健康的身体，因此每天锻炼身心皆受益。
entries.note: ①古罗马谚语（源出尤维纳利斯）；②健康生活——论证身心关系，用于第二段。

entries.en: Health is not valued till sickness comes.
entries.zh: 人只有在生病时才珍惜健康。
entries.example: Health is not valued till sickness comes, so young people should not stay up late.
entries.exampleZh: 人只有在生病时才珍惜健康，因此年轻人不应熬夜。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②健康生活——论证健康意识，用于分析或建议段。

entries.en: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
entries.zh: 未来属于那些相信梦想之美的人。
entries.example: Eleanor Roosevelt insisted that the future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
entries.exampleZh: 埃莉诺·罗斯福坚信，未来属于那些相信梦想之美的人。
entries.note: ①Eleanor Roosevelt；②个人品质——梦想类结尾升华句，适合末段收束。

entries.en: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
entries.zh: 预测未来的最好方式就是创造未来。
entries.example: As Peter Drucker observed, the best way to predict the future is to create it.
entries.exampleZh: 正如彼得·德鲁克所言，预测未来的最好方式就是创造未来。
entries.note: ①常引作Peter Drucker；②经济职业——号召主动作为，宜用于结尾段。

entries.en: Be the change you wish to see in the world.
entries.zh: 成为你希望在这个世界上看到的改变。
entries.example: Gandhi urged us to be the change we wish to see in the world.
entries.exampleZh: 甘地呼吁我们成为我们希望在这个世界上看到的改变。
entries.note: ①Mahatma Gandhi；②社会公德——结尾段行动号召，可与措施句连用。

entries.en: Diligence is the mother of good fortune.
entries.example: Cervantes declared that diligence is the mother of good fortune, and effort never betrays us.
entries.exampleZh: 塞万提斯宣称，勤奋是好运之母，努力从不会辜负我们。
entries.note: ①Miguel de Cervantes；②经济职业——论证勤奋与机遇，用于论证段。

entries.en: Lost time is never found again.
entries.zh: 失去的时间再也找不回来。
entries.example: Benjamin Franklin warned that lost time is never found again, so we must treasure it.
entries.exampleZh: 本杰明·富兰克林告诫说，失去的时间再也找不回来，因此我们必须珍惜它。
entries.note: ①Benjamin Franklin；②学习与教育——论证珍惜时间，用于建议或结论段。

entries.en: Charity begins at home.
entries.example: Charity begins at home, so caring for our parents comes before helping strangers.
entries.exampleZh: 仁爱始于家庭，因此关爱父母先于帮助陌生人。
entries.note: ①英语谚语；②家庭情感——论证孝亲与家庭责任，用于第二段。

entries.en: Little strokes fell great oaks.
entries.zh: 一斧一斧砍下去，巨橡也会倒。
entries.example: Little strokes fell great oaks, and small daily efforts finally reshape a person.
entries.exampleZh: 一斧一斧砍下去巨橡也会倒，每天微小的努力终能重塑一个人。
entries.note: ①Benjamin Franklin；②个人品质——论证积少成多，用于第二段论证。

entries.en: Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors.
entries.zh: 平静的海面练不出熟练的水手。
entries.example: Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors, so hardship often builds real competence.
entries.exampleZh: 平静的海面练不出熟练的水手，因此艰难往往造就真正的能力。
entries.note: ①African proverb（非洲谚语）；②个人品质——论证磨砺与成长，用于第二段。

entries.en: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
entries.zh: 早睡早起使人健康、富有而明智。
entries.example: As Franklin said, early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
entries.exampleZh: 正如富兰克林所说，早睡早起使人健康、富有而明智。
entries.note: ①Benjamin Franklin；②健康生活——论证规律作息，用于第二段或建议段。

entries.en: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
entries.zh: 取得进展的秘诀在于开始行动。
entries.example: Mark Twain believed that the secret of getting ahead is getting started, not perfect planning.
entries.exampleZh: 马克·吐温认为，取得进展的秘诀在于开始行动，而非完美的计划。
entries.note: ①Mark Twain；②经济职业——鼓励立即行动，宜用于结尾段号召。

entries.en: Coming together is a beginning, staying together is progress, and working together is success.
entries.zh: 相聚是开始，相守是进步，合作才是成功。
entries.example: Henry Ford once remarked that coming together is a beginning, staying together is progress, and working together is success.
entries.exampleZh: 亨利·福特曾说，相聚是开始，相守是进步，合作才是成功。
entries.note: ①Henry Ford；②经济职业——论证团队合作，可作第二段主旨句。
